Nambari kubwa kwa 3 zaidi ya kubingirisha nambari mbili za zushfwa mara mbili mfululizo:

$$
\text{Pandekani mafuta} = (3 + 1) \times 1000 = 4000
$$

$$
\text{Pandekani zaidi} = 4000 + 1000 = 5000
$$

$$
\text{Pandekani mafuta} = 5000 - 1000 = 4000
$$

$$
\text{Pandekani mafuta} = 4000 \times 1000 = 4000000
$$
